title: Craftmine Timer
description: that mod adds 20 minutes timer to 25w14craftmine snapshot! (not customizable!!!!🥸)
body:
# TIMER IN ROUGELITE MINECRAFT!!!!

i thought it will be a great idea to add a simple timer to a rougelite snapshot so there is

## what is this

This mod adds a 20 minutes timer after witch game will start you to kill. Also it has (kind of) multiplayer compactibility. I think in future there will be some translation and random events but idk. have fun!!!
